title: Parker Solar Probe crossed into the Sun's atmosphere in 2021
body: In April 2021 NASA's Parker Solar Probe passed into the corona, the Sun's outer atmosphere. The probe found that the outer boundary it crossed was uneven instead of lying at a fixed distance from the Sun.
takeaway: A spacecraft can measure where the solar wind begins to escape, rather than relying entirely on distant observations.
source: NASA Science, Parker Solar Probe Touches the Sun (2021)

title: Apollo 12 astronauts visited a robot already on the Moon
body: Surveyor 3 landed on the Moon in 1967. In November 1969, Apollo 12 astronauts walked to it and removed components, including its camera, to bring back to Earth.
takeaway: The visit turned an earlier mission into a test of how equipment weathers on the lunar surface.
visual: a lunar astronaut beside a small uncrewed lander in a shallow crater

title: Viking 1 photographed its own footpad on Mars
body: On 20 July 1976, NASA's Viking 1 took the first photograph from the surface of Mars minutes after landing. The monochrome image included stones, soil and part of a lander footpad.
takeaway: The first view gave engineers a close look at the ground where their machine had come to rest.
source: NASA Science, First Photograph Taken on Mars Surface
